title: Fixed Continuous Cutaway U Tube and Blank Board
description: One newly authored complete static U-tube instrument appearance. A low full foot supports one tall shaped backing board. One genuinely continuous thick U-shaped vessel has two equal-height open upper ends, parallel legs and a smooth lower return bend. Its complete front half is deliberately cut away; two continuous finite section lips and two half-annular end faces close the opaque wall mesh while leaving a real connected inner channel. Four separate rear bridges hold the actual rear wall to the board. One narrow blank central comparison strip on two complete brackets sits between the legs. This is not the old one-ended blind cistern tube with enlarged reservoir and cursor, and not a solid branching stethoscope hose with chest disc. All visible geometry newly authored, no old vessel or hose mesh extracted. Four opaque constant PBR materials. One fixed whole model, zero scenes. Empty illustrative cutaway only: no fluid, glass transparency, pressure containment, vacuum, calibrated reading, pressure difference, motion, physical demonstration, material compatibility, fabrication, operation or safety performance claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made and outside static scope.
